summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K on July 2, 2026, disclosing director/PDMR share transactions under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. On June 30, 2026, CFO Dawn Allen received vesting of a Performance Share Plan award of 283,193 ordinary shares at nil exercise price, with subsequent sale of 133,300 shares at 3.523867 GBP per share to cover tax liabilities. The filing is a routine compliance report on an equity grant and sale, with no special-situation corporate action. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change.
